item.title: Softball sweeps Mount Aloysuis after 6-2 trip to Myrtle - The Yellow Jacket
item.description: Earlier today, the Waynesburg University Yellow Jackets softball team returned home from a trip to the Fastpitch Dreams Spring Classic by sweeping a doubleheader over Mount Aloysius College. item.title: Men’s Tennis completes Sunday sweep of Pitt-Greensburg - The Yellow Jacket
item.description: Waynesburg’s first match after spring break was a success, defeating Pitt-Greensburg over the weekend 7-0. Things got kicked off in doubles, where Waynesburg’s only loss of the day was suffered, as sophomore Ethan Clawson and junior Tyler Gordon were taken down 6-1 in the first doubles. item.title: Does the United States overlook the Winter Olympics? - The Yellow Jacket
item.description: Over the past two years, the United States has participated in two Olympic Games: the 2024 Summer Paris Olympics and the 2026 Winter Milan Cortina Olympics. These events are covered globally and are highly supported within our country. But do we support one more than the other? Do the Summer Olympics really receive more coverage? … Continue reading
